description: This Java source file is an Android activity class named MainActivity. It demonstrates various text linkification techniques including auto-linking URLs and phone numbers, parsing HTML from resources and code, and manually creating styled and clickable spans within a TextView. The class sets up multiple TextView elements with different linkification methods in its onCreate() method.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity illustrating different approaches to making text links clickable in a TextView, including auto-linking, HTML parsing, and manual span creation.
